stories.title: Netflix 測試語言模型作為手工構建推薦邏輯的替代方案 / Netflix tests language model as alternative to hand-built recommendation logic

sources.title: Netflix 測試語言模型作為手工構建推薦邏輯的替代方案 / Netflix tests language model as alternative to hand-built recommendation logic
sources.title_zh: Netflix 測試語言模型作為手工構建推薦邏輯的替代方案
sources.title_en: Netflix tests language model as alternative to hand-built recommendation logic
sources.title_original: Netflix tests language model as alternative to hand-built recommendation logic
sources.summary: Netflix pitted its years-old recommendation engine against an in-house language model called GenRec and says it got better results. Instead of relying on thousands of hand-crafted features, GenRec converts viewing behavior into plain text. Netflix itself calls it "an early but promising step." The article Netflix tests language model as alternative to hand-built recommendation logic appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Netflix 將其已有多年曆史的推薦引擎與名為 GenRec 的內部語言模型進行了比較，並表示獲得了更好的結果。 GenRec 不依賴數千個手工製作的功能，而是將觀看行為轉換為純文字。 Netflix 自己稱其為“早期但有希望的一步”。 Netflix 測試語言模型作為手工構建推薦邏輯的替代品的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

sources.summary: Deepseek has released V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, an experimental multimodal model that adds image understanding to V4-Flash's text capabilities. sources.title_zh: 心理學方法揭示人工智慧安全測試的主要弱點
sources.title_en: Psychological methods reveal major weaknesses in AI security testing
sources.title_original: Psychological methods reveal major weaknesses in AI security testing
sources.summary: Researchers at the UK AI Security Institute used psychometric methods to show that popular safety benchmarks for language models don't measure one consistent trait. Blanket blocking of requests can artificially inflate a safety score even as the model gets less useful day to day. The study also offers a method for catching models that act more cautious during tests than they do in normal use. The article Psychological methods reveal major weaknesses in AI security testing appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 英國人工智慧安全研究所的研究人員使用心理測量方法表明，流行的語言模型安全基準並不能衡量一種一致的特徵。即使模型的用處日益減少，對請求的全面阻止也會人為地提高安全分數。該研究還提供了一種方法來捕獲在測試期間比正常使用時表現得更加謹慎的模型。文章《心理學方法揭示人工智慧安全測試的主要弱點》首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

sources.title_en: Anthropic puts its most powerful model Claude Mythos 5 to work for cyber defense
sources.title_original: Anthropic puts its most powerful model Claude Mythos 5 to work for cyber defense
sources.summary: Anthropic is now running its security scanner Claude Security on Claude Mythos 5. The tool scans codebases for vulnerabilities, provides severity ratings with CWE classifications, and suggests patches. Anthropic is also plugging Mythos 5 into partner security products protecting critical infrastructure. The article Anthropic puts its most powerful model Claude Mythos 5 to work for cyber defense appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 現在在 Claude Mythos 5 上執行其安全掃描器 Claude Security。該工具掃描程式碼庫中的漏洞，提供 CWE 分類的嚴重性評級，並建議補丁。 Anthropic 還將 Mythos 5 插入合作伙伴安全產品中，保護關鍵基礎設施。文章《Anthropic 將其最強大的模型 Claude Mythos 5 用於網路防禦》首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

sources.title_zh: 隨著 Anthropic 收復失地，GPT-5.6 Sol 帶動 OpenAI's 收入激增

sources.title_original: GPT-5.6 Sol drives OpenAI's revenue surge as it regains ground on Anthropic
sources.summary: Since GPT-5.6 Sol launched in early July, OpenAI says revenue is up 35 percent this quarter, with enterprise revenue growing more than 50 percent. Ramp data shows OpenAI outpacing Anthropic in business API spending for the first time after Anthropic had overtaken OpenAI in quarterly revenue. The article GPT-5.6 Sol drives OpenAI's revenue surge as it regains ground on Anthropic appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 自 GPT-5.6 Sol 於 7 月初推出以來，OpenAI 表示本季度收入增長了 35%，其中企業收入增長超過 50%。斜坡資料顯示，繼 Anthropic 的季度收入超過 OpenAI 後，OpenAI 的業務 API 支出首次超過 Anthropic。文章《GPT-5.6 Sol 推動 OpenAI's 收入激增，因為它在 Anthropic 上重新站穩了腳跟》首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

stories.title: Anthropic 將 Claude Mythos 5 引入 Claude 安全性：企業團隊無需直接訪問模型即可進行前沿漏洞掃描 / Anthropic Brings Claude Mythos 5 to Claude Security: Enterprise Teams Get Frontier Vulnerability Scanning Without Direct Model Access

sources.title: Anthropic 將 Claude Mythos 5 引入 Claude 安全性：企業團隊無需直接訪問模型即可進行前沿漏洞掃描 / Anthropic Brings Claude Mythos 5 to Claude Security: Enterprise Teams Get Frontier Vulnerability Scanning Without Direct Model Access
sources.title_zh: Anthropic 將 Claude Mythos 5 引入 Claude 安全性：企業團隊無需直接訪問模型即可進行前沿漏洞掃描
sources.title_en: Anthropic Brings Claude Mythos 5 to Claude Security: Enterprise Teams Get Frontier Vulnerability Scanning Without Direct Model Access
sources.title_original: Anthropic Brings Claude Mythos 5 to Claude Security: Enterprise Teams Get Frontier Vulnerability Scanning Without Direct Model Access
sources.summary: Anthropic has moved its most cyber-capable model into a product security teams can switch on themselves. Claude Security scans now run on Claude Mythos 5, in public beta for Claude Enterprise customers with no separate model add-on. The scan connects to a GitHub repository, traces data flows across files, and returns findings with a CWE category, confidence and severity ratings, and a suggested patch. The design point is packaging: users receive a scan result rather than a prompt box, so the model that finds vulnerabilities cannot be steered into writing exploits. The post Anthropic Brings Claude Mythos 5 to Claude Security: Enterprise Teams Get Frontier Vulnerability Scanning Without Direct Model Access appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 已將其最具網路能力的模型轉變為安全團隊可以自行切換的產品。 Claude 安全掃描現在在 Claude Mythos 5 上執行，這是針對 Claude Enterprise 客戶的公開測試版，沒有單獨的模型附加元件。掃描連線到 GitHub 儲存庫，跟蹤檔案之間的資料流，並返回包含 CWE 類別、置信度和嚴重性評級以及建議補丁的結果。設計要點是打包：使用者收到的是掃描結果而不是提示框，因此發現漏洞的模型無法引導編寫漏洞利用程式。 Anthropic 將 Claude Mythos 5 引入 Claude 安全性：企業團隊無需直接模型訪問即可進行前沿漏洞掃描一文首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items.title_original: Anthropic Brings Claude Mythos 5 to Claude Security: Enterprise Teams Get Frontier Vulnerability Scanning Without Direct Model Access
items.summary: Anthropic has moved its most cyber-capable model into a product security teams can switch on themselves. Claude Security scans now run on Claude Mythos 5, in public beta for Claude Enterprise customers with no separate model add-on. The scan connects to a GitHub repository, traces data flows across files, and returns findings with a CWE category, confidence and severity ratings, and a suggested patch. The design point is packaging: users receive a scan result rather than a prompt box, so the model that finds vulnerabilities cannot be steered into writing exploits. The post Anthropic Brings Claude Mythos 5 to Claude Security: Enterprise Teams Get Frontier Vulnerability Scanning Without Direct Model Access appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 已將其最具網路能力的模型轉變為安全團隊可以自行切換的產品。 Claude 安全掃描現在在 Claude Mythos 5 上執行，這是針對 Claude Enterprise 客戶的公開測試版，沒有單獨的模型附加元件。掃描連線到 GitHub 儲存庫，跟蹤檔案之間的資料流，並返回包含 CWE 類別、置信度和嚴重性評級以及建議補丁的結果。設計要點是打包：使用者收到的是掃描結果而不是提示框，因此發現漏洞的模型無法引導編寫漏洞利用程式。 Anthropic 將 Claude Mythos 5 引入 Claude 安全性：企業團隊無需直接模型訪問即可進行前沿漏洞掃描一文首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

sources.summary: Andreessen Horowitz has two partners sitting on the boards of companies that now compete with each other: Ben Horowitz at Databricks and Martin Casado at Fivetran. Nothing too scandalous on the surface, except the Department of Justice has reportedly been investigating the arrangement for almost a year, dusting off a 112-year-old antitrust law that’s rarely used against VCs. Board conflicts aren’t exactly new, and these companies weren’t necessarily direct competitors when a16z first invested […]
sources.summary_zh: Andreessen Horowitz 有兩位合夥人在目前相互競爭的公司董事會中任職：Databricks 的 Ben Horowitz 和 Fivetran 的 Martin Casado。表面上看，並沒有什麼太醜聞的地方，只是據報道，司法部已經對這一安排進行了近一年的調查，並重新制定了一項已有 112 年曆史的反壟斷法，該法很少用於針對風險投資公司。董事會衝突並不是什麼新鮮事，當 a16z 第一次投資時，這些公司不一定是直接競爭對手 […]

sources.summary: In August 2025, TypeScript became the most used language on GitHub. This was the largest shift in GitHub’s language rankings in the last ten years and it occurred during the period of most accelerated adoption of coding AI agents. Coding AI agents had previously been predicted to lower the importance of language selection. It was […] The post How AI coding tools are contributing to the popularity of JavaScript appeared first on AI News .
sources.summary_zh: 2025 年 8 月，TypeScript 成為 GitHub 上最常用的語言。這是過去十年來 GitHub 語言排名發生的最大變化，而且發生在編碼 AI 代理加速採用的時期。此前預測人工智慧代理的編碼會降低語言選擇的重要性。這是 [...] 這篇文章《AI 編碼工具如何促進 JavaScript 的流行》首先出現在 AI News 上。

sources.summary: 走進新呈工業位於臺北汐止區康寧街的工廠，七樓靠窗辦公室裡，桌上3臺筆電同時運作，一臺正打開ChatGPT分析營運策略，中間那臺執行Claude Code最新收到的開發任務。還有一臺部署開源AI代理Hermes Agent，24小時監控行銷數據和客戶來信。 這是新呈工業董事長陳泳睿的辦公室，對他來說，企業推動AI轉型，經營者不能只要求員工採用，自己也必須成為第一線的實踐者。 去年Vibe Coding技術爆紅，多年前的工程師魂讓他一時手癢，動手用AI開發了一套客服系統，「以前用嘴叫IT部門寫程式，現在改叫AI寫程式。」他笑著說。

sources.title: 構建代理文件智慧管道：使用 AutoFigure 建立科學圖形 / Building Agentic Document Intelligence Pipelines: Creating Scientific Figures with AutoFigure
sources.title_zh: 構建代理文件智慧管道：使用 AutoFigure 建立科學圖形
sources.title_en: Building Agentic Document Intelligence Pipelines: Creating Scientific Figures with AutoFigure
sources.title_original: Building Agentic Document Intelligence Pipelines: Creating Scientific Figures with AutoFigure
sources.summary: This tutorial explores AutoFigure, a practical toolkit for generating professional scientific figures directly from text descriptions and research papers. We walk through setting up the environment, configuring an API-backed generation workflow, and converting complex document intelligence pipelines into publication-style diagrams, complete with custom reference styling and gallery exports. The post Building Agentic Document Intelligence Pipelines: Creating Scientific Figures with AutoFigure appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: 本教程將探討 AutoFigure，這是一個實用的工具包，用於直接從文字描述和研究論文生成專業的科學圖表。我們將逐步介紹環境設定、配置 API 支援的生成工作流程，以及將複雜的文件智慧管道轉換為出版物樣式的圖表，並提供自定義參考樣式和相簿匯出。帖子“構建代理文件智慧管道：使用 AutoFigure 建立科學圖形”首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

sources.title: Cursor公開Origin底層Git架構，以S3預寫日誌因應AI代理大量儲存庫
sources.title_zh: Cursor公開Origin底層Git架構，以S3預寫日誌因應AI代理大量儲存庫
sources.title_original: Cursor公開Origin底層Git架構，以S3預寫日誌因應AI代理大量儲存庫
sources.summary: Cursor公開程式碼託管服務Origin的底層Git儲存系統Continuity，採用S3相容物件儲存中的預寫日誌（WAL）保存每次推送的資料，本機Git儲存庫則成為可隨時重建的快取。新架構主要因應兩種負載，一是企業持續擴大的大型單一儲存庫，另一種則是AI代理大量建立但很少使用的小型儲存庫。

sources.title: llm 0.32.1
sources.summary: Release: llm 0.32.1 Fresh installs of LLM stopped working the other day because the OpenAI Python library dropped its usage of httpx , and it turned out LLM depended on that library but only installed it via a transitive openai dependency. This dot-release fixes that for the moment by pinning to openai<3 , and a soon-to-drop 0.33 release will switch from httpx to httpx2 . Tags: httpx , openai , llm
sources.summary_zh: 版本：llm 0.32.1 前幾天，新安裝的 LLM 停止工作，因為 OpenAI Python 庫放棄了 httpx 的使用，結果發現 LLM 依賴於該庫，但僅透過傳遞 openai 依賴項安裝它。這個點版本透過固定到 openai<3 暫時修復了這個問題，並且即將釋出的 0.33 版本將從 httpx 切換到 httpx2 。標籤： httpx , openai , llm

sources.title_en: llm-openrouter 0.7
sources.title_original: llm-openrouter 0.7
sources.summary: Release: llm-openrouter 0.7 Now that this plugin is compatible with LLM 0.32 it can display the reasoning traces for LLMs available through OpenRouter. Updated for compatibility with LLM 0.32 . Models now use OpenRouter's implementation of the Responses API . Three new server-side tools: Shell , WebFetch , and WebSearch . Enable these with options like -T WebSearch . Tags: llm , openrouter
sources.summary_zh: 版本：llm-openrouter 0.7 現在該外掛與 LLM 0.32 相容，它可以顯示透過 OpenRouter 提供的 LLMs 的推理跟蹤。更新為與 LLM 0.32 相容。模型現在使用 OpenRouter 的 Responses API 實現。三個新的伺服器端工具： Shell 、 WebFetch 和 WebSearch 。使用 -T WebSearch 等選項啟用這些。標籤： LLM , 開放路由器

sources.title_original: Mac版ChatGPT新增Apple Messages外掛、歐盟地區加入電腦使用紀錄
sources.summary: macOS版ChatGPT及Codex本週加入數項功能，包括能為使用者傳送Apple訊息、Codex使用者可分享對話串給他人、歐盟地區使用者還能獲得電腦使用紀錄。 本週OpenAI為macOS版ChatGPT及代理式開發工具Codex加入的第一項功能是新增Apple Messages外掛。現在各方案的ChatGPT macOS版App都能安裝，不過只有Codex和ChatGPT Work才能啟用新功能。安裝完成後，ChatGPT就能讀取和搜尋iMessages、簡訊或RCS訊息，還能代使用者從Messages App傳送訊息。

stories.title: Slack推出Slack Code，讓團隊與AI代理人共同開發程式

sources.title: Slack推出Slack Code，讓團隊與AI代理人共同開發程式
sources.title_zh: Slack推出Slack Code，讓團隊與AI代理人共同開發程式
sources.title_original: Slack推出Slack Code，讓團隊與AI代理人共同開發程式
sources.summary: Salesforce週四（8/20）推出Slack Code，讓企業團隊可在Slack中與AI程式代理人共同開發、檢視及修改程式碼。 Slack過去已能整合各種AI代理人，但相關功能主要用於對話及個別任務。隨著Claude Code、Devin、GitHub Copilot及ChatGPT等代理人開始處理更複雜的程式開發，開發者與AI的討論及修改過程通常只有自己看得到，其他團隊成員難以同步參與。
